description: The article adopts Kagan's (1994) four basic principles of cooperative learning, captured by the acronym PIES: \"Positive interdependence, Individual accountability, Equal participation, Simultaneous interaction\".
title: Kagan's PIES principles of cooperative learning

description: KCLS is a content-free, step-by-step structural approach to cooperative learning consisting of \"contemporary psycho-social behaviours with social interaction sequences which can transform teaching\".
title: Kagan's structural approach to cooperative learning (KCLS)

description: Architectonics is defined in the article as \"the constructive role of cognition in perception\" and as \"the 'art of systems'\" — the unity of manifold cognition under one idea.
title: Kantian architectonics: a theory of the systematic, constructivist organization of relations in cognition and higher education

description: The Kantian Effect is the article's proposed metaphor for the scholarship of integration and a paradigm for reimagining interdisciplinarity.
title: The Kantian Effect: a metaphor and paradigm linking intertextuality and interdisciplinarity through four dialogic principles
